title: 엽연초생산협동조합법시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:20720:20080229:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20720, February 29, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but not yet effective shall take effect on the respective effective dates of those Presidential Decrees.
Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.
Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (46) Omitted.
(47) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act shall be amended as follows:
In the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, Article 7 (1) and (2), Articles 10, and the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 11, "Minister of Finance and Economy" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Strategy and Finance."
(48) through (68) Omitted.
